name: Wetterkreuzhütte
beschreibung: The Wetterkreuzhütte is situated at an altitude of approximately 1,400 metres in the Ötztal valley, surrounded by alpine meadows and mountain forests. This holiday home features authentic alpine interiors complete with rustic wood panelling and a traditional tiled stove. The property is accessed via a scenic mountain road, which may require snow chains during the winter months. The world-renowned ski resort of Sölden is roughly a 25-minute drive away. The cabin is an ideal retreat for hikers and nature enthusiasts looking for peace and seclusion away from busy tourist hubs.
